profile.name: Li Guoqiu (李国球)
profile.company: Alibaba Group — Taobao Technology (淘天业务技术)
bio: I am a Senior Algorithm Engineer at Alibaba Group’s Taobao Technology Department, where I focus on research and development in AIGC for indoor spatial applications.

My research focuses on 3D content generation and physics-driven world models, with a particular interest in bridging generative AI, computer vision, and computer graphics to enable machines to understand and create realistic 3D worlds.
I received an M.S. in Artificial Intelligence from Tsinghua University and a B.Eng. in Electronic Information from Huazhong University of Science and Technology.

news.text: Our technical report “Home3D 1.0: A High-Fidelity Image-to-3D Asset Generation System for Interior Design” is publicly available on arXiv!
Promoted to Senior Algorithm Engineer at Alibaba Group.
Invited speaker at A2M 2024, presenting “AIGC+3D：开创家居导购新时代”
Joined Taobao Technology, Alibaba Group, as an Algorithm Engineer.
